title: Approximability of Triangulated Categories under Separable Extensions
summary: In this paper, we investigate the behavior of approximability under separable extensions of triangulated categories. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be an approximable triangulated category and let $\mathbf{T}=(T,θ,μ)$ be a smashing, stably separable exact monad on $\mathcal{B}$. Assume that the category of $\mathbf{T}$-modules $\mathbf{T}\text{-}\mathrm{Mod}_{\mathcal{B}}$ admits a canonical triangulated structure.
